title: trisepalum amplexicaule
intro: Trisepalum amplexicaule, commonly known as the climbing trisepalum, is a plant species that belongs to the Gesneriaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Trisepalum amplexicaule include expectorant and antitussive properties, which aid in the relief of respiratory congestion and coughing. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include trisepalumine and other flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
